Supersedes config_version 2.
note: Schedules in MARKET timezone, converted to UTC per-date (DST-aware). NY-times reflect when OANDA is EXPECTED TO PRODUCE STREAM DATA, not merely when an underlying exchange is open. Evidence: hermes_market_hours DB (metals daily break 21:00-22:00 UTC = 17:00-18:00 EDT) + observed Incident #1104 (XAU no data 20:59-22:04 UTC on 2026-07-15 EDT). Every configured instrument MUST map explicitly; unmapped/unvalidated -> resolves to None -> FAIL LOUD (behave as open, normal detection). No secrets. Design-only until separately deployed.
holiday_semantics: No governed holiday calendar. On public holidays / provider closures / shortened sessions / exceptional shutdowns / off-break provider maintenance, the schedule is NOT holiday-aware -> the instrument is treated per its normal weekly/daily rule. If the market is actually closed on a holiday while the rule says open, expected data will be absent and a stale incident MAY fire (incident NOISE). Deliberate: noise is preferred over fault-hiding. A governed holiday calendar is a separate future WO.
